notes.content:

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.content:
We fixed a bug that affected the sound effects. Sometimes, the first collected coin in a level wouldn't play its sound.

This should we working as expected, now.

notes.title: Discord link fix
notes.content: A small update to change the link to our Discord server.

notes.title: Massi vs. José is NOW AVAILABLE!!
notes.content: [p]Hello! Hope you're doing well.[/p][p][/p][p]The time has finally come: [b]Massi vs. José is now available for purchase, here, on Steam[/b]!! We've learned a lot while developing this game, our first time working with Steam, and we're so proud of the end result.[/p][p][/p][p]Explore [b]8 different themed worlds[/b], discover new platforms, get collectibles and aim for the top score in each level. [b]Unlock achievements[/b] and climb the scoreboards, too! We can't wait for you to try the other 5 worlds that are not available in the demo version.[/p][p][/p][p]We have a [b]20% discount[/b] for the first week 👀.[/p][p][/p][p]We've received a good amount of feedback with the mobile version (both Android and iOS), and we would really appreciate if you support this new release![/p][p][/p][p]GO GO GO![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support, keep playing and stay tuned for our [b]upcoming projects[/b] 🤩.[/p]

notes.title: Massi vs. José will be released on September 1st!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301336/9c8745eaad57ef202d60af0b4088164ae163bbbb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello! Hope you're doing well.[/p][p][/p][p]We've finished working on the last level for our game, so it's finally ready for a full release 🤩. It has been quite a journey, we've learnt a lot and we're proud of our creation![/p][p][/p][p]This being said, we've set the release date to [b]September 1st, 2025[/b]. The full version is now available on the Google Play Store and it's on its way to the App Store. The Steam demo has been updated too, to include all the latest bug fixes and improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait for you to explore all of our challenging levels and to enjoy our beautiful music and pixel art![/p][p][/p][p]The game will release at [b]$4.99[/b], with a [b]launch discount of 20%[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks a lot for your support and see you soon![/p]

notes.title: Bug fixes!!
notes.content: [p]Hello! Hope you're doing well.[/p][p][/p][p]We've released a small update to fix two bugs:[/p][list][*][p][b]Sound Effects:[/b] sound effects played even when the game was paused. From now on, they will pause and resume when the game does![/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosive Platforms:[/b] Do you remember the last fix we published for explosive platforms? Well, it broke something else. Massi couldn't trigger their explosion when touching the platform with her head or body. We've fixed this, too![/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks a lot for your support.[/p]

notes.title: World 3, for FREE!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301336/0489dff9ab986e35fc0a93d4c8029b97246e3791.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello! Hope you're doing well.[/p][p][/p][p]Today's update is an important one! The demo version of Massi vs. José now includes the first 3 Worlds of the game, for a total of 15 levels for you to play. Discover the [b]Volcano[/b] and face the challenges 👀.[/p][p][/p][p]Remember, the progress you have in the demo should carry on to the full version when it releases.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks a lot for your support and keep playing![/p]

notes.title: Fullscreen fix 🔧
notes.content: [p]Hello! Hope you're doing well. This is a quick and small update:[/p][list][*][p][b][u]Fullscreen fix:[/u][/b] The fullscreen toggle didn't work as expected when used alongside the resolutions dropdown. Also, the game is supposed to launch in fullscreen for the first time. This has been fixed![/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks a lot for your support! Stay tuned.[/p]

notes.title: Explosive platforms not... exploding?
notes.content: [p]Hello! Hope you're doing well.[/p][p]We've been hard at work with the last world of the game: World 8! Once we finish the remaining 4 levels, we will announce a release date, so stay tuned!![/p][p]Today's update is a small one but it's very crucial:[/p][list][*][p][b]Explosive platforms:[/b] the player could jump in an almost frame-perfect timing on top of the explosive platform, and it wouldn't activate it. This has been fixed in the Demo version.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks a lot for your support, and keep playing!![/p]

notes.title: Difficulty tweaks, mouse cursor and Steam overlay
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're doing well.

Here we are with another update for the game!!

- [b]NEW:[/b] When you beat a level and unlock the next one, it will be selected by default.
- [b]NEW:[/b] The mouse cursor is now hidden while playing.
- [b]NEW:[/b] The game will pause when the Steam overlay is activated.
- [b]FIX:[/b] Some difficulty tweaks for levels 1-2 and 1-4.

We're hard at work with World 7, almost finishing the game.

Thanks a lot for your support and keep playing!!

notes.title: Change Game Settings from Pause Menu!
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're doing well.

This is a quick update. Now you'll be able to open the game settings directly from the Pause Menu.
[list]
[*] Set volume, toggle music and sound effects.
[*] Change resolution
[*] Switch language
[/list]

Thanks a lot for playing, and stay tuned!

notes.title: Don't get lost. Camera Preview is here!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=MuA466vHm-E;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello! Hope you're doing well.

We've been working on the game, currently designing and creating the levels for World 6. We've also added a really helpful feature: [b]Camera Preview[/b].

Use it to get a glimpse of the level before exploring, find the best path and locate the key and the collectibles!

You can use the arrows on screen, your gamepad joysticks or dragging the screen to move the camera.

Hope you like it!

notes.title: Use your controller!
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're doing well.

Just a quick notice that our game now has better controller support!

Use the triggers or bumps to switch between worlds on the Level Selection screen.

Thanks a lot for your support and keep playing!

notes.title: More time and collectibles improvements!!
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're doing well.

We have very important updates today:
[list]
[*] [b]500 seconds for all levels:[/b] Complete levels at your pace, take your time, get everything.
[*] [b]Reworked collectibles:[/b] Previously, if you repeated a level, you needed to search for all collectibles again to get 3 stars. Not anymore! From now on, just focus on missing collectibles and you will be rewarded at the end.
[/list]
That's it for now! We've been really hard at work with World 6 and we hope to share more details soon.

Thanks for supporting us!

- José

notes.title: Happy New Year!!
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're doing well.

2024 was a wonderful year for Gammes. We started (and almost finished) the development of our first commercial game "Massi vs. José". Also, our previous games reached new milestones on Google Play!

We will have more interesting news, coming soon.

On behalf of our team: Happy New Year 2025!!

notes.title: Cloud Saves Fix - Get the latest update!
notes.content:
Hello!

The demo had an issue with Cloud Saves. It seems that Steam didn't recognize the format of the save files. So, in this update:
[list]
[*] Reworked Save / Load System
[*] Fixed Steam Cloud Saves
[/list]

Make sure you have the latest update installed. Now available for both Windows and Mac.

Thanks for your support!!

notes.title: Massi vs. José Demo is now available!
notes.content:
Hello! Hope you're doing well.

Just a quick announcement for today: [b]Massi vs. José Demo[/b] is now available on Steam, for free!

Beat the [b]first 10 levels[/b], get all the stars and [b]carry over your progress[/b] once the full game releases.

We would love to hear some feedback.

Stay tuned and keep playing!!

notes.title: Massi vs. José store page is live. Wishlist now!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301336/e15bb40faa89bc5ae5fff069050489ae1c317b05.png[/img]

Hello! Hope you are doing well.

We've been hard at work with the Steam version of Massi vs. José, and today we took the first step to its full release: our store page has been approved and published!

We're so excited to bring an amazing experience with our game. We would really appreciate if you can add the game to your wishlist and spread the word.

As a reminder, the game will have [b]8 worlds[/b], each one with [b]5 levels[/b], so a total of [b]40 levels[/b]. Right now, we're finishing World 5!

Thanks a lot for your support and stay tuned.
